BaseInput.description: Input of the inner method, exactly as that method accepts it. It is validated by the inner method at run time against its own schema; this schema does not describe it.

TornadoVariable.description: One input to vary, with its low and high values.

high.description: High value of the input, in its units.

low.description: Low value of the input, in its units; lower than `high`.

variable.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to a decimal input of the inner method, for example
`/discount_rate`. Variables do not repeat.

base_input.description:
Input of that method, complete: the base case. Each variable is changed alone, the
others keep their base values.

method.description: Id of the method to evaluate, for example `dcf.fcff`. Analysis methods are not accepted.

output.description:
RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the decimal output to rank, in the `value` of the inner
result, for example `/equity_value`.

variables.description: The inputs to vary; at least one.
